shortDescription: This module manages portset configuration on IBM Storage Virtualize family systems

options.name: autozoneenabled
options.description: Enables automatic zone creation when the portset is used during host creation or modification.

options.name: autozonepolicy
options.description: Specifies the auto zone policy to be applied when C(autozoneenabled) is set to yes. C(one_to_one) zones each host WWPN to exactly one IO port from its portset on the same fabric. C(one_to_one_all_fabrics) zones each host WWPN to one IO port per fabric and does not require the host WWPN and IO port to be on the same fabric.

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Storage Virtualize system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Storage Virtualize system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: noownershipgroup
options.description: Specify to remove the ownership group from portset. Parameters I(ownershipgroup) and I(noownershipgroup) are mutually exclusive. Applies only during updation of portset.

options.name: old_name
options.description: Specifies the old name of the portset while renaming. Valid when I(state=present), to rename an existing host.

options.name: ownershipgroup
options.description: The name of the ownership group to which the portset object is being mapped. Parameters I(ownershipgroup) and I(noownershipgroup) are mutually exclusive. Applies when I(state=present).

options.name: password
options.description: REST API password for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.

options.name: portset_type
options.description: Specifies the type for the portset. Applies only during creation of portset. If not specified, I(portset_type=host) will be used.

options.name: porttype
options.description: Specifies the type of port that can be mapped to the portset. Applies when I(state=present). If not specified, I(porttype=ethernet) will be used to manage IP portset.

options.name: replicationportsetlinkuid
options.description: Change the replication_portset_link_uid parameter of the portset.

options.name: resetreplicationportsetlinkuid
options.description: Reset the replication_portset_link_uid parameter to a newly generated portset link UID.

options.name: state
options.description: Creates (C(present)) or Deletes (C(absent)) the IP portset.

options.name: token
options.description: The authentication token to verify a user on the Storage Virtualize system. To generate a token, use the M(ibm.storage_virtualize.ibm_svc_auth) module.

options.name: username
options.description: REST API username for the Storage Virtualize system. The parameters I(username) and I(password) are required if not using I(token) to authenticate a user.
